title.zh: 英伟达GR00T研究员创业：融资9000万美元，推出跨机型机器人AI
title.en: 英伟达GR00T研究员创业：融资9000万美元，推出跨机型机器人AI

current_state.zh: Ex-NVIDIA GR00T researchers' startup Dream Labs raised a $90M seed round and released the Dream-1 cross-robot manipulation model API, which beat Gemini 4 Argon on third-party task-progress benchmarks at far lower cost while still showing limited end-to-end success rates in research testing.
